name: zoto-equation-art
description: Images as invented math: text→program→image and image→program from sandboxed eqart-ir/2 equation programs, fractal SVG (IFS, L-systems, spirals, escape-time sets) with exact round-trips, and WebGPU/WebGL2 3D viewer export.

interface.longDescription: Generate images as sandboxed equation programs (closed forms, SDFs, cellular automata, PDEs, per-pixel iteration) with a render-and-critique loop, render 18 fractal presets to generative SVG / PNG / programs and fit fractals back from SVGs and images, and export programs as self-contained WebGPU/WebGL2 3D viewers. Optional Jev decisions on improvement iterations when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set.
